title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch (deferred schema loading)
description: Used ToolSearch to load moeb MCP tool schemas during fix_signal execution. No moeb equivalent exists for loading deferred tool schemas at runtime.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb equivalent covering deferred schema loading, or pre-load all tool schemas in the fix_signal prompt output.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000057: ToolSearch is a legitimate pre-skill bootstrapping tool (no moeb equivalent needed); moeb-tool-origin rubric needs updating to exempt it.
